coverage.summary: Residential rental property in Santa Ana. Certain types of residential property are exempt, including housing produced in the last 15 years, deed-restricted affordable housing, hotel and transient occupancy, hospital and care facilities, dormitories, and other shared living quarters.
coverage.other_conditions: Protection applies once a tenancy has lasted 30 days. The exemption list is introduced with 'including', so it may not be exhaustive.

result.notes: I set supersedes_state_rule to null. No document mentions Cal. Civ. Code § 1946.2, a binding finding, or displacement of state just-cause law, so I also removed that sentence from the summary. I set min_building_age_years to null because it duplicated the 15-year new-construction exemption. It also treated the exemption as a rolling age test, which the source does not establish: the source says 'housing produced in the last 15 years' with no reference date. I set construction_date_basis to null because the basis is not stated anywhere. The new-construction exemption, the unverifiable exemptions and the 30-day tenancy condition are kept, each supported by D085.
